title: Cheap plastic cracks easily!!!  Quality control is lacking too…
text:
Cheap plastic cracks easily!!! Quality control is lacking too…. [[VIDEOID:f8c9ab592e102b2072f15f5e0f51098b]] Not very impressed. I like how these are stackable and foldable. But, that is where the great idea ends. The brittle plastic means these will see the dumpster soon. I like the size and was planning to put these to good use. For now, I will have to go with more ‘rubber like’ crates.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
